guidebook.intro: Hali ya hewa kwa Kiingereza huanza na “It”, na jana huanza na “was”.

tips.title: “It’s windy”
body: Kiingereza huanza hali ya hewa kwa **It**: **It’s windy** (kuna upepo), **It’s cloudy** (kuna mawingu), **It’s sunny** (kuna jua).
Nomino nyingi huwa hali kwa kuongeza **-y**: **wind → windy**, **cloud → cloudy**, **sun → sunny**.

tips.title: Jana: was na were
body: Wakati uliopita wa **is/am** ni **was**: **It was cold.** (Kulikuwa na baridi.) **I was at home.** (Nilikuwa nyumbani.)
Kwa **you, we, they** tumia **were**: **We were at school.** Vitenzi vingi huongeza **-ed**: **rain → rained**.

culture.title: Masika na vuli
body: Kiingereza hakina majina ya masika na vuli. Sema **the long rains** na **the short rains**, na **the dry season** kwa kiangazi.
